newsitem.title: USA: Sight Resource has shareholder rights plan.
newsitem.headline: Sight Resource has shareholder rights plan.

text.p: Sight Resource Corp said Friday that its board of directors has adopted a shareholder rights plan, but that it was not doing so in response to any known effort to acquire the company.

Once in place, the company said that the rights plan allows Sight Resource shareholders to purchase common stock in Sight Resource or in the acquirer at a substantial discount, once any person or group acquires 15 percent of the company's shares, or tenders for that amount of stock.

Sight Resource Corporation provides primary eye care products and services through its 72 primary eye care centers, 10 laser vision correction centers and integrated networks of opticians, optometrists and ophthalmologists.
